question: Do owners approve `skills.securityReview` as the permanent operator-admin pre-install trust contract for native clients?
rationale: The line-level unavailable-verdict defect is mechanically repairable, but establishing a new cross-client security API and mobile skill-installation boundary requires explicit Gateway and app-owner intent.

options.title: Approve after fail-closed repair
options.body: Keep the dedicated admin RPC, disable Install without a valid verdict, and prove that its identity and disposition semantics remain aligned with final install enforcement.

options.title: Fold review into installation
options.body: Use a server-issued review token or canonical review-and-install operation if owners do not want a separate permanent preflight method.

options.title: Defer Android installation
options.body: Limit the PR to installed-skill search, filtering, and toggles until native package installation receives product sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Approve after fail-closed repair
recommendation.body: Keep the dedicated admin RPC, disable Install without a valid verdict, and prove that its identity and disposition semantics remain aligned with final install enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history most directly covers Gateway skills methods, authorization scopes, and shared protocol changes.
